questions.stem: A U-tube manometer has two ends column A and column B. Column A is connected with a tank and column B is open to the atmosphere, then the mercury in the tube stands 20cm higher in column A than column B. What is the pressure in the tank in Kpa?

**Step 4:** Calculate the pressure difference: $$ \Delta P = 13600 \times 10 \times 0.2 = 27200 \text{ Pa} = 27.2 \text{ kPa} $$.
**Step 5:** Subtract from atmospheric pressure: $$ P_{tank} = 101.3 \text{ kPa} - 27.2 \text{ kPa} = 74.1 \text{ kPa} $$.
